Card Q&A.a: Yes, it leaves the battle area. If the "by doing X" condition isn't met, the rest of the effect isn't processed. In such cases, this card leaves the battle area if the deletion isn't possible.
Card Q&A.q: I attempted to delete 1 of my other Digimon using this card's 1st [All Turns] effect when this card would leave the battle area other than in battle, but I couldn't delete that Digimon due to another effect. Does this card leave the battle area at such times?

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn’t trigger. As soon as the player chooses to activate an [X Per Turn] effect, it will count toward 1 use of [X Per Turn]. In this case, as soon as you attempt to delete another Digimon using this card's 1st [All Turns] effect, it will count toward [1 Per Turn], and the effect won't trigger again during that turn.
Card Q&A.q: I tried to delete my opponent's EX7-061 [Lilithmon (X Antibody)] using this card's 1st [All Turns] effect. At such times, if my opponent tries to delete this card using the 1st [All Turns] effect on the chosen EX7-061 [Lilithmon (X Antibody)], does this card’s 1st [All Turns] effect trigger again?

Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, if [Lilithmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, by deleting 1 other Digimon, it doesn't leave.

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When other Digimon are deleted, if it's your turn, you may play 1 level 4 or lower purple Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost. If it's your opponent's, trash their top security card.
Type: Demon Lord/X Antibody/Seven Great Demon Lords
